newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Esec 1996/97 income falls to 11 mln Sfrs.
newsitem.headline: Esec 1996/97 income falls to 11 mln Sfrs.

text.p: Esec Holding AG said consolidated net income for the 1996/97 financial year to end February fell to 11 million Swiss francs from 26 million for the previous year.
Esec, a Swiss producer of assembly equipment for the semiconductor industry, said net sales rose to 345 million francs, up 70 percent from the year before.
The company earlier reported sales for the period at 325 million.
Esec said the higher sales figure was due to changes in the company's foreign exchange structure following the takeover of Zevatech, a U.S.-based silicon packaging group, last year.
The 1996/97 income figure reflected amortisations of eight million Swiss francs.
The company has proposed paying dividends of 1.1 million Swiss francs for the 1996/97 year, against 2.6 million francs for the previous year.
This reduces the dividend to 4.2 francs per bearer share from 11 francs in the previous year.
Esec said a total of 116 million Swiss francs raised in a capital increase last August would be used to set off against the 164 million francs paid in the Zevatech purchase.
